Take your passion for physics to the next level with a graduate degree from NDSU. Designed for students with a strong foundation in physics, the program offers Master of Science and doctorate degrees tailored to your academic and research ambitions. At NDSU, you’ll work alongside renowned faculty in a research-intensive environment, with opportunities to explore experimental, theoretical and computational physics. Whether it’s investigating polymer physics, advancing physics education research or pioneering remote sensing techniques, the program empowers you to contribute to groundbreaking discoveries.

Shape Your Future
At NDSU, you’ll have a dedicated academic advisor who will partner with you to create a personalized plan that aligns with your unique goals and supports your success.
Personalize Your Degree
Make your degree fit your unique career aspirations by diving deep into specialized training in biophysics, computational physics, condensed matter, nanomaterials, physics education research, polymer physics, soft matter physics and statistical mechanics.
Rewarding Research
As a research-intensive department, you’ll work alongside expert faculty on groundbreaking research in nanomaterials, soft condensed matter, biophysics, remote sensing and physics education research.
Work in the Best Environment
Work in NDSU’s Materials and Nanotechnology Center, located in the Research and Technology Park. The Center is equipped with two state-of-the-art wet labs, a synthesis lab, optical characterization facilities and surface characterization facilities.
Professional Development and Leadership
Broaden your horizons and expand your experience outside of the classroom through student organizations, including the Physics Graduate Student Group, open to any NDSU student, faculty or staff member with an interest in physics. Participation in student organizations help build strong connections with peers and allow you to develop leadership skills.
